name: Hannan Shakib Dynamic Notice or Class Materials for Elementor
author: hannanshakib

sections.description:
Hannan Shakib Dynamic Notice or Class Materials for Elementor is a robust and lightweight plugin designed specifically for educational institutions, online tutors, and instructors to manage downloadable assets.

With a custom post type dedicated exclusively to “Notice or Class Materials”, you can seamlessly upload files, assign dates, categorize the materials, and display them in a visually stunning grid via our exclusive Elementor widget.

Features

  • Custom Post Type & Taxonomy: Keeps your standard blog posts separate from your notices and materials.
  • Unlimited File Attachments: A dynamic repeater field lets you attach multiple downloadable files (PDFs, docs, images, etc.) to a single notice.
  • Elementor Integration: A brand new “HS Notice or Class Materials Grid” widget is added directly to your Elementor builder.
  • Extensive Styling: Easily customize typography (looks great with modern fonts like Poppins), colors, margins, padding, and box shadows.
  • Advanced Query Controls: Filter materials by category, set custom post limits, and control pagination alignment.
  • Toggle Display Elements: Easily hide or show category badges and file names depending on your layout needs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hannan-shakib-dynamic-notice-or-class-materials-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Notice or Class Materials” in your WordPress dashboard menu to start creating content.
  4. Edit any page with Elementor and drag the “HS Notice or Class Materials Grid” widget onto the canvas.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor is required to use the frontend grid widget.

Can I upload multiple files to one notice?

Absolutely. The backend meta box includes a dynamic “+ Add File” button allowing for multiple files per entry.

Where can I get support?

For any plugin updates or custom development needs, please visit www.hannanshakib.com or reach out via WhatsApp at the number provided in the widget’s ‘About Developer’ tab.
